Message:
SLUB Debug: Fix object size calculation

The object size calculation is wrong if !CONFIG_SLUB_DEBUG because the
#ifdef CONFIG_SLUB_DEBUG is now switching off the size adjustments for
DESTROY_BY_RCU and ctor.
